title: Application
description: Which application, at which version, the model was derived from. Actors are required rather than optional: an actor vocabulary is a property of the application, so a model that cannot name who it is describing has not finished describing it.

base_url.description: Entry point for the crawler/agent, e.g. https://example.com

repository.description: Code repository that source_mappings paths are relative to.

version.description: Either a free-form string (git:abc123) or a structured descriptor.

actors.description: Roles the application can be exercised as. Referenced by id from state.identity.variant and journey.actor; the id is the join, so both sides must name one of these.

credentials_ref.description: Name of a secret/credential entry. Never store raw credentials in the graph.

environments.description: Optional map of environment name -> base url, when the graph is reused across environments.
